premises.text: Voice control technology currently has limited compatibility with popular apps.

premises.text: Existing voice control apps limit their technology to only a few apps.

premises.text: VoiceFear integrates with 20 of the most popular apps from the start.

premises.text: VoiceFear allows users to interact with apps without leaving the app interface.

premises.text: VoiceFear's API hub enables easy integration of new apps.

premises.text: VoiceFear can improve access to complex software for professionals.
